details.description: Stable Image Search and Replace is an image-editing model from Stability AI that locates an object in an uploaded image, described in a search_prompt parameter, and replaces it with new content described by a separate prompt, without requiring a manual mask. Amazon Bedrock lists a model launch date of October 2024 for this model, and Stability AI's current Stable Image product page still lists 'Search and replace' among its editing tools. Amazon Bedrock lists the model's lifecycle as Active with no confirmed end-of-life date, though its originally stated 'no sooner than' retirement window of October 2025 has passed.
advantages: Finds the object to replace from a text description in a search_prompt parameter rather than a manually drawn mask, per AWS Bedrock's sample request body.
disadvantages: Replaces one identified object per request rather than performing open-ended image generation or editing multiple objects at once.
use_cases: Swapping an item of clothing or a product shown in a photo for a different one.
Editing a scene by replacing a background object with different content.
Producing creative image variations without manual masking or a reshoot.

notes: AWS's sample request uses prompt for the replacement content and search_prompt for the object to find, e.g. replacing a 'sweater' with a 'jacket'. Bedrock's model card lists lifecycle as Active with EOL date N/A, even though the model's originally stated 'no sooner than' end-of-life window (Oct 2025) has already passed; no source states it is deprecated or superseded.
